summary: Pilot-only: compare stab05/stab03/top20F screens by honest 2x5 nested CV of HistGradientBoostingClassifier; lock best
reasoning: I use the sealed screen result of vote step-22 (stab screen, nested cv 0.73, 20 features) whose code is in this snapshot, and fleet2-boost step-25's runner-measured pilot-only result (stability screen + tuned GBM: cv_auc 0.7645, 10 features) plus stable-forest step-56's GINI-screen precedent (10 features, cv 0.7554) to expect that a F-bootstrap stability screen fed to HistGradientBoostingClassifier reaches nested pilot cv_auc >= 0.70 with <= 50 features. I compare thr=0.5 (~10 feats), thr=0.3 (~20 feats) and top-20 F on pilot only, picks locked by mean nested CV over 2 repeats; the chosen variant's cv_auc and full-pilot n_features are written to out/metrics.json. If no variant reaches 0.70 the plan is contradicted and I will rework the screen (e.g. GINI-importance bootstrap) before locking anything.
